before_conditions: OraclePack.getEMAs() returns a tuple in the order (spotEMA, fastEMA, slowEMA, eonsEMA, medianTick)
RiskEngine.twapEMA calls oraclePack.getEMAs() and destructures its returned tuple
RiskEngine.twapEMA binds the first three returned values as (eonsEMA, slowEMA, fastEMA, , )
required_property: RiskEngine.twapEMA should bind the EMA components to the correct variables matching the return order of OraclePack.getEMAs(), so that the blended tick it returns is computed from the intended spotEMA, fastEMA, slowEMA, and eonsEMA inputs, protecting downstream components that rely on this TWAP for pricing, risk, margin, safe-mode gating, and liquidation decisions.
bad_outcome: RiskEngine.twapEMA returns an incorrect time-weighted price signal because the EMA components are swapped and the real eonsEMA is dropped, which can distort downstream pricing, risk, margin, safe-mode gating, and liquidation decisions, leading to mispriced risk, wrongful liquidations, missed liquidations, or systemic solvency issues.
